evals.prompt: set up rngo for this project — infer channels and effects from the codebase.
evals.expected_output: A .rngo/ directory with spec.yml, a db channel (target.type stream, format.type sql, pointed at the local Postgres via psql/DATABASE_URL), and one effect per Prisma model (User, Post, Comment) with schemas that faithfully translate each field: uuid ids as unanchored string patterns, the PostStatus enum as select/constant, isAdmin as select/constant true|false, nullable body as select-with-null, authorId/postId as reference+function.
assertions: the .rngo directory (produced by rngo run --stdout with no parse error) contains a db channel and effects for user, post, and comment creation
no effect or channel file uses the old system:/format:{table:} field names instead of channel:/metadata:
the PostStatus enum is expressed via select of constant options, not an invented enum type
the isAdmin boolean is expressed via select between constant true and constant false
the nullable Post.body field is expressed via select between the real schema and a null constant
foreign keys (authorId, postId) are expressed via reference (optionally wrapped in function)
no string pattern contains ^ or $ regex anchors
rngo run --stdout against the produced .rngo directory exits without a parse/build error and emits events

evals.prompt: set up rngo for this project — infer channels and effects from the codebase.
evals.expected_output: A .rngo/ directory with spec.yml, a db channel for the local Postgres, and one effect per SQLAlchemy model (Product, Order, OrderItem) with schemas translating: integer autoincrement ids as number/scale:0/step:1, the OrderStatus enum as select/constant, in_stock boolean as select/constant true|false, nullable tracking_number as select-with-null, order_id/product_id as reference+function.
assertions: the .rngo directory (produced by rngo run --stdout with no parse error) contains a db channel and effects for product, order, and order_item creation
no effect or channel file uses the old system:/format:{table:} field names instead of channel:/metadata:
integer autoincrement primary keys use number with scale: 0 (and step: 1 where appropriate) rather than a string pattern
the OrderStatus enum is expressed via select of constant options
the in_stock boolean is expressed via select between constant true and constant false
the nullable tracking_number field is expressed via select between the real schema and a null constant
foreign keys (order_id, product_id) are expressed via reference (optionally wrapped in function)
rngo run --stdout against the produced .rngo directory exits without a parse/build error and emits events

evals.prompt: add an invariant that an order can never be fulfilled before it has been paid.
evals.expected_output: A new file under .rngo/invariants/ with type: sql, a query over the effects table (or effects+signals) that would catch a fulfillments.create effect whose order_id has no corresponding payments.create effect, and an expect: result == 0 (or equivalent) CEL expression. The pre-existing spec.yml/channels/effects are left intact.
assertions: a new file exists under .rngo/invariants/
the invariant has type: sql, a query field, and an expect field
the query references both the fulfillments and payments (or orders) effects, joined or filtered on order_id
the expect expression is a CEL comparison against result (e.g. result == 0)
the pre-existing spec.yml and effects/*.yml files are unchanged from the original fixture
rngo run --stdout against the produced .rngo directory exits without a parse/build error and emits events
